file_roles.evidence: Distinct merge code called accumulate(aAcc, k) with the whole Row k; fix adds parametersCodeForDistinctMerge that unpacks fields via k.getField(i) with boxed casts.

rationale: ClassCastException (Row to Integer) surfaces in SumAggFunction.accumulate, called from generated mergeAccumulatorsPair. The generator passed the Row instead of its fields, and the diff fixes that generated call.
